entities.name: zoning code
entities.description: The official set of rules and standards that govern land use, building codes, and development within the city, including amendments and updates to zoning policies.

entities.name: Parking and Access
entities.description: Regulations and standards related to parking facilities, requirements, and access points within the city, including provisions for reducing parking requirements for affordable housing near transit stops.

entities.name: affordable housing
entities.description: Housing units that are affordable to low- and moderate-income residents, often supported by city policies and incentives, including considerations for parking reductions near transit.

entities.name: Live Local Act
entities.description: Florida legislation (Ch. 2023-17) that encourages local governments to consider reducing parking requirements for affordable housing near major transit stops.

entities.name: parking reductions
entities.description: Policies or provisions that allow for the reduction of parking requirements for certain types of developments, such as affordable housing near transit stops, as mandated by state legislation.
